name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Call once per new observation with 1–4 complete frames from the same episode, oldest first. Defaults summarize bilateral tactile changes, measured hand displacement, and visible camera depth. Optional camera_rois selects normalized [row_start,column_start,row_end,column_end] regions; selected regions also report four local surface normals in row-major order and their disagreement. marker_change_px defaults to 2 pixels; rgb_change defaults to 0.02 normalized intensity. Output includes frame indices mapped to recorded steps, compact adjacent comparisons, separate latest and peak evidence, and a time-gated summary of decreasing tactile change at a nearly fixed hand. Missing measurements are null or explicitly unknown. Repeated simulation states do not count as temporal evidence. Marker matching uses reference coordinates, never cross-frame row identity. Reference continuity is assumed within the supplied episode unless metadata contradicts it. RGB scale is reported as declared or inferred. Initial references may already be loaded; native tactile depth is camera depth in millimetres, not indentation. Image changes and marker vectors do not establish force, slip, contact absence, hidden geometry, or completion. Surface normals describe only visible patches. One frame provides current measurements only. Results remain below 6000 JSON characters; any budget omissions are listed.

camera_rois.description: Optional normalized [r0,c0,r1,c1] regions, with exclusive ends and increasing bounds. Omitted cameras use their full image. Explicit regions enable four-tile surface diagnostics.

marker_change_px.description: Descriptive threshold on median spatially matched marker change, in pixels.

rgb_change.description: Per-pixel mean absolute RGB difference threshold after normalization; an image is flagged when over 1% of valid pixels exceed it.
